test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 4: Teacher Responds and Updates the Course
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher logs in to respond to forum and update session
test_cases.pre_condition: The student 'student_newuser@example.com' has posted a new question in the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course forum. A Teacher account ('GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com') exists in the system and is associated with this course.
test_cases.expected_result: The user is authenticated, their session is initiated, and they are redirected to the Dashboard Page.
test_cases.post_condition: A Teacher with a valid session is logged into the system and is on the Dashboard Page, with access to all managed courses.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Logout' button in the user menu.
